//: Auth (+ Storage, for E2E only) emulators. Every surface authenticates through Firebase — the backend verifies tokens with firebase-admin, and both the admin and mobile apps sign in with the Firebase JS SDK — so pointing all three at the Auth emulator lets tests mint real tokens through the real code paths, with no network and no shared live project. The Storage emulator was added so mobile E2E can drive uploads (nanny ID/avatar, marketplace listing photos) without a live bucket; its rules (storage.rules) are open and are NEVER deployed. Firestore/Functions remain deliberately absent.
